title.from: Owner decision needed: if dynamic retrieval beats the fixed default by 3+ points, does the default stay fixed?
title.to: Owner decision: the fixed example list is the default; dynamic retrieval stays optional

description.from:
## Owner decision needed (Q3)

Do not assume an answer. The plan only **reports** the comparison.

If dynamic retrieval plus features (A+D) beats the fixed default (A-c+F) by **≥3 points** on paper-600, does the default stay fixed, or does retrieval become the default (for example for small pools)?

## Definition of done

Answer recorded here once the results page exists (the owner may also answer earlier). Cost: $0.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §5.4, §7 Q3.
description.to:
## Decided (owner, 2026-10-01, Q3)

The optimized **fixed** example list is the default because it is simple to set up and deploy for inference. Dynamic retrieval is **not** the default regardless of any benchmark result, because it is harder to deploy: it needs a slow in-memory vector search at inference, or a vector store to set up, or a weaker non-semantic word match.

The earlier framing (whether a retrieval win would change the default) is moot: no comparison threshold applies. A retrieval comparison, if run, is only reported.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §5.4, §7 Q3.
